status: Shared paper palette: consistent semantic roles across method diagrams and result plots

adm.meaning: Our ADM or action-selection scaling, consistently across RL, actor+ADM and API figures.

lookahead.meaning: Future rollout observations and teacher/evidence paths use salmon. Action tokens retain purple, including inside teacher inputs.

oracle.meaning: Outcome-based oracle and outcome-label supervision; train/eval use related shades.

single_call.meaning: Single-call inference scaling; effort, tokens and browser-step budgets use shades/line styles.

success.meaning: Successful terminal outcomes use filled green dots, explicitly distinguished from green state cards by shape and labels.

failure.meaning: Failed rollout outcomes; keep hollow marks where already established.

attention.meaning: Allowed attention cells; primary purple structural encoding.

state.meaning: Current observation/context s_t only; green fill with dark text and darker green borders. Future rollout states are lookahead evidence and use salmon.

action.meaning: Candidate and selected-action tokens; purple fill with darker purple text.

neutral_roles.MUTED: Secondary text, baseline references and frontier links
neutral_roles.BASELINE_LIGHT: First actor-only control and pre-execution labels
neutral_roles.BORDER: Axes, masks and thin box boundaries
neutral_roles.BACKGROUND: White canvas; soft fills derive from base colors rather than new hues
neutral_roles.PRE_EXEC: Pre-execution teacher labels; explicit semantic alias of an actor-baseline neutral
neutral_roles.ATTENTION_MASKED: Masked attention connections; derive from the neutral background/border
neutral_roles.FRONTIER: Pareto-frontier rings and dashed links; neutral structural role
neutral_roles.STATE_INK: Readable dark text on current-context cards; FUTURE_STATE_INK provides contrast on salmon future-evidence cards.

non_color_encodings.teacher_vs_student: Teachers use hollow circles colored by label source. Students use light-purple fills with thick warm label-source outlines: yellow Pre-exec, salmon-orange Lookahead, amber Oracle. Explicit H labels distinguish horizons.
non_color_encodings.actor_model_family: Marker shape in model comparisons; add a shape rather than a new color per model
non_color_encodings.configuration: Line style, fill and ordered tones within the same semantic family; define each figure legend explicitly
non_color_encodings.lookahead_horizon: Explicit H labels and x-axis positions distinguish horizons; all lookahead teachers/evidence share salmon.

horizon_convention.definition: H counts the candidate action plus continuation actions

notes: Role variables remain distinct even when a chosen palette intentionally shares a family.
Shared named roles apply across method diagrams and result plots; historical figure populations and estimates remain unchanged.
The H=1 role is retained for method/evidence illustrations; former post-execution result series are omitted from most plots, with the teacher/student horizon comparison explicitly restoring H=1.
The seven base colors are user choices; light/dark tones are derived, not independent choices.

category_cycle.purpose: External reference methods or diagnostic categories with no role above
category_cycle.rule: Use a figure-local ordered cycle drawn from the seven families, their tones and neutrals; no additional base-color choices required. Always label the categories explicitly.

proposal.status: Shared paper colors applied across method and result renderers
proposal.strategy: Palette 3 supplies ADM purples; palette 1 supplies semantic accents; palette 2 supplies neutral controls and text.
proposal.derived_colors: Warm amber blends the supplied yellow #EDE374 with salmon #ED8B74. Lookahead uses the original salmon at every horizon; darker green marks and light gray fills remain derived from their source swatches.
rules: Use light purple #9575EE for default ADM and ADM-22M; use dark purple #654FA1 for ADM-4B wherever its size is identified. ADM hue intensity encodes model size, not the label teacher.

Salmon #ED8B74 identifies lookahead teacher/evidence; purple identifies the learned ADM. Horizons are distinguished by H labels and positions. In label-source comparisons, keep teacher circles hollow and label-source-colored, and make all learned ADM-22M student points solid light purple. Student fills keep purple, with thick warm outlines to identify label sources (yellow Pre-exec, salmon-orange Lookahead, amber Oracle).

Use original yellow #EDE374 for Train and the 50% yellow-salmon blend #EDB774 for Eval and Oracle, widening Train/Eval separation. Labels and CI bars remain neutral. Mint keeps its darker related tone for small success marks.
Teacher/student fill, actor-model shapes and cached shading remain independent of hue.

Purple identifies ADM, all candidate/continuation/selected action tokens, scoring paths and allowed attention. Salmon identifies future rollout states, lookahead evidence and teacher paths. Green identifies CURRENT state/context only. Yellow/amber identify outcome-label train/eval accents. Green success dots and hollow gray failures use explicit status labels.

trial.status: Applied across all registered paper figures; frozen scientific inputs and estimates preserved
trial.student_label_outline: Student ADM-22M uses light-purple fills and thick warm outlines: yellow for Pre-exec labels, salmon-orange for Lookahead labels, amber for Oracle labels. Explicit H labels distinguish horizons.

diagram_roles.state: Current observation/context s_t: green cards. Future rollout states s_(t+h): salmon evidence cards, using FUTURE_STATE roles.
diagram_roles.lookahead: Salmon future-state/evidence enclosure and teacher cues. Candidate/continuation action tokens retain purple, including teacher-input formulas.
diagram_roles.adm: Light purple default/22M; dark purple only for 4B selector size where applicable.
diagram_roles.status: Filled green dots mean success; hollow gray dots mean failure. State/action cards identify content, not outcomes.
diagram_roles.attention: Primary purple cells encode allowed attention; neutral masks.
